subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should the team schedule this measured route-entry extraction now, or explicitly defer it under the broader web-performance program?
rationale: Source confirms the coupling, but implementation should proceed only when a maintainer sponsors the measurement window and accepts the issue's evidence-based stop/go outcome.

options.title: Schedule the measured A/B
options.body: Run the legacy-route and one-detail-route extraction with identical build and cold-navigation measurements before expanding scope.

options.title: Defer under the umbrella
options.body: Keep the issue open but postpone the experiment until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2925 is actively scheduled.

recommendation.title: Schedule the measured A/B
recommendation.body: Run the legacy-route and one-detail-route extraction with identical build and cold-navigation measurements before expanding scope.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current measurement context and adjacent performance investigation, so they are best positioned to frame the scheduling decision.
